digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) management and indexing
propositions: ADR directory contains 91 files with only 69 distinct numbers, resulting in 17 duplicate-numbered ADRs (including five numbered 0037) creating ambiguity and collision risk

Collisions historically result from stale-base merges rather than true races, preventable via per-number marker files (docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN) that produce git add/add conflicts for same-number submissions
22 duplicate-numbered ADRs must be renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order while earliest-landed ADRs retain their original numbers

Cross-references to collision-group ADRs throughout docs/ and src/ must be rewritten to point to the correct final number, with resolution method (slug-exact, topic-matched, ancestry, or unresolved) recorded in RENUMBERING.md
CI checks (check_adr_numbers.py) must enforce bijection between ADR files and marker files, prevent duplicate numbers, and verify all adr/NNNN-slug markdown links resolve to existing files
A generated docs/adr/README.md index must group ADRs by workstream and display full slugs for discoverability
